{{Top|leg}}
The '''Department of Personnel''' was a division of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]]. It was charged with tracking all personnel both active and retired, paying them, assigning [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] to mission, and filing all miscellaneous information received. It was an established and efficient bureaucracy.
